sub_claims.claim_text: On zinc plating Zn-N bonds form at pyridinic-nitrogen sites, moving their chemical state toward graphitic nitrogen

evidence.observation: After zinc deposition the ~398 eV N 1s feature collapses and the ~401 eV feature becomes the taller of the two

evidence.observation: HAADF-STEM of zinc-loaded carbon shows bright zinc at three scales: isolated points, ~1 nm blobs and extended lattice-resolved patches
